title: K-injective representative form of the intrinsic direct compositor coordinates
statement: For every finite commutative coefficient ring and composable scheme maps, the intrinsic direct-image compositor coordinate equation holds on a K-injective complex representative.

source.place: Coefficient-presentation normalization in step 2 of lem-sf-system-finite-compositor-coordinates; K-injective representative substep.

proof.text: Use the normalized ordinary adjunction transport and the fixed-scalar direct-image comparison to identify the two coefficient presentations on a K-injective complex. The ambient finite compositor mate equation and the derived unit normalization give the corresponding equality after localization.
Paste the naturality squares for the two direct-image comparisons with the fixed-scalar compositor and cancel the equivalence unit and counit. This gives the displayed equality on the representative.

proof_origin.place: K-injective representative substep of the coefficient-presentation normalization; split from the parent theorem so the representative calculation can be proved independently.

mathlib_searches.results: Existing derived-category representative and K-injective resolution declarations were used; no exact compositor coordinate theorem was found.

from.place: K-injective representative substep of the parent proof.

lean.statement:
theorem sfIntrinsicDirectCompositorCoordinates_kInjective
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (I : CochainComplex (Sheaf (ProEt.topology X)
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} A))) ℤ) [I.IsKInjective] :
    let B := ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} A)
    let af := (sfIntrinsicConstantModuleAdjunction f A).mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction
    let ag := (sfIntrinsicConstantModuleAdjunction g A).mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction
    let adjt := (sfIntrinsicConstantModuleAdjunction
      (f ≫ g) A).mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction
    (proEtaleConstantDerivedDirectImage g A).map
        ((sfIntrinsicDerivedDirectImageComparison f A).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)) ≫
      (sfIntrinsicDerivedDirectImageComparison g A).hom.app
        ((lowerStar B f).rightDerivedFunctor.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)) ≫
      (sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence Z A).functor.map
        ((conjugateIsoEquiv
          ((derivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction B g).comp
            (derivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction B f))
          (derivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction B (f ≫ g))
          (leftDerivedUpperStarComp B f g)).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)) =
    (conjugateIsoEquiv (ag.comp af) adjt
      (sfIntrinsicDerivedPullbackComp A f g)).hom.app
        ((sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence X A).functor.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)) ≫
      (sfIntrinsicDerivedDirectImageComparison (f ≫ g) A).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)
